purpose: Machine-readable index of durable anti-patterns and known dead ends; content authority remains PRODUCT-KNOWLEDGE.md and endorsed continuity records.

entries.rule: Do not reopen the old Three.js module-resolution hypothesis without new evidence.
Treat missing canonical GLB binaries as the current P04 blocker; do not weaken assertions or substitute unrelated geometry.
Do not restore superseded WalkMyPlan architecture to make current tests pass.
Do not promote a derived representation to replace master/HomeFinder.sh3d authority without an explicit endorsed architecture decision.
HTTP/static availability is not application success; validate intended runtime markers and behavior.
Do not weaken meaningful acceptance assertions to conceal upstream failures.
Use actual source geometry/coordinates and evidence; never invent spatial truth to satisfy a renderer.
Update the minimum complete canonical set determined by impact; do not mechanically touch every document.
Do not promote incomplete remote API views as full project census totals; run the census from a checked-out repository.
Preserve active HomeFinder dictionary ownership and create structural indexes only when a real ownership gap exists.
Treat history rewriting as a separate Git/branch-reconciliation gate; never silently rewrite main or a shared validation branch.
